Since we have derived “Harry is red,” the statement follows.

Rule 4: If Harry is kind then Harry is cold. We have Harry kind, so derive Harry cold.

Rule 6: All cold people are red. So Harry cold implies Harry red. So indeed, we derive Harry red.

Thus statement follows: True.
